sources.title: Komi-Perm Archive fond 30: Chyormoz Nativity of the Mother of God church records
notes: Opis 2 contains 31 parish-register units for several churches and districts across 1839–1918; it is not a continuous Chyormoz series.
The Chyormoz Nativity church units visible in this opis are item 2 for 1874 (141 sheets) and item 2A for 1886 (103 sheets). No Chyormoz book for 1898 appears in this opis.
Opis 1 contains only Kochevo St Nicholas confession registers for 1899–1901 and is not relevant to Chyormoz.

sources.title: Chyormoz factory personnel and administrative fonds
notes: Fond R-75 covers the Chyormoz Metallurgical Plant, 1912–1956, including personnel-related materials; fond 280 covers the Abamelek-Lazarev estate and Chyormoz works before nationalization.

sources.title: Ivanovskoye and its St John the Baptist Church, Solikamsky Uyezd
notes: Ivanovskoye became the center of Ivanovskaya Volost in 1861 and had a St John the Baptist Church consecrated in 1851.
Syrchiki is listed among the nearby villages. This makes Ivanovskoye the leading parish candidate for a Syrchiki birth in 1898, but the parish assignment still requires direct confirmation.
